$comment: UCOS-UTCE-001 — UNIVERSAL TRACEABILITY CLOSURE ENGINE (declaration). This file is DATA and
is the ONLY place this programme's constitutional obligations, rooting relations, lineage
relations, derivation rules, obligation classes, validation dimensions and exit criteria are
stated. utce_engine.py contains no lane name, no relationship type, no artifact identifier
and no label: the thirteen-stage lane vocabulary and the relationship vocabulary are both
READ at run time from the located sources that own them.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME MEASURES, AND WHY THE DISTINCTION MATTERS. Two different obligations
have been conflated in this repository under one word.
(1) THE CONSTITUTIONAL OBLIGATION. CEP-001 XVIII.1 requires every artifact to trace UPWARD
to its authorizing ratified definition and DOWNWARD to its reproducible evidence;
XVIII.2 and CEP-008 XI.2 require that traceability be rooted and closed with ZERO
orphans and that every link resolve to an existing endpoint. That is the obligation
CEP-006 V.1 and CEP-007 V.1 both name as the ratification and freeze precondition, in
those exact words: 'rooted-and-closed traceability (CEP-001 Article XVIII)'. It says
nothing about a thirteen-lane spine. This programme measures it, and it is BLOCKING.
(2) THE ENGINEERING SPINE. The registry schema carries a thirteen-stage traceability field,
and the located measurement service reports one incomplete-traceability gap for any
artifact whose thirteen lanes are not ALL populated. That is a richer engineering model
than the constitution requires, and it is where the repository's largest measured
number lives. This programme measures it too, reports it UNCHANGED, and does NOT
redefine it. It is recorded here as non-blocking with a named owner.
NO PREDICATE IS WEAKENED AND NO LINK IS FABRICATED. This programme writes nothing into the
certified corpus, populates no lane, and invents no relationship. Where it reports that a
lane entry is DERIVABLE it names the located edge identifier that would support it, so every
derivable count is auditable against 00-BOOK/DATA/relationships.json. A derivable entry is
not a written entry, and this programme is careful never to report it as one.
THE REACHABILITY DEFECT IS THE ROOT CAUSE, AND IT IS MEASURED HERE. Five of the thirteen
lanes are named by NO label in the located relationship vocabulary, so no artifact in this
repository can populate them by any means the located generator provides. A predicate
requiring all thirteen therefore has no reachable satisfying state — the same defect class
the certification programme already recorded once as FAIL-CLOSED-WITHOUT-PASS-PATH. This
programme measures which lanes have a collection mechanism and which do not, and refers the
absent mechanisms to the located owner of the vocabulary. That is the constitutional
mechanism for COLLECTING the missing evidence, which CEP-008 Article XIV requires, rather
than synthetic evidence, which CEP-008 IX.2 and X.4 forbid.

programme.name: Universal Traceability Closure Engine
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme is READ-ONLY over the certified corpus. It populates no lane, writes no relationship, changes no predicate and owns no measurement service. It measures the constitutional traceability obligation, reports the engineering spine unchanged, and records what would be needed to discharge each open obligation.
programme.disclosure: **DISCLOSURE.** CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL. The constitutional traceability obligation of CEP-001 Article XVIII is measured here and is BLOCKING. The thirteen-lane engineering spine is a richer model owned by platform/measurement and 00-BOOK/tools; its completeness is reported here unchanged and is NOT closed by this programme.

$corpus_comment: The certified corpus is READ, never written. Every path below is opened read-only and the
write-scope guard proves this programme's only write target is its own operational home.
$vocabulary_comment: Both vocabularies are READ from the located modules that own them, by static analysis of
their source rather than by import: importing would execute the module and make this engine
depend on the very code it is measuring. A lane added to the schema, or a label added to the
vocabulary, is therefore discovered here automatically.

$obligation_comment: The constitutional obligations, each bound to the clause that imposes it. A clause whose
text is absent from its instrument is a binding failure, not a silent pass.

$rooting_comment: Rooting relations. An artifact is ROOTED when at least one located edge of one of these
types points from it to an authorizing or superior artifact. These are not invented: each
names a type of the located relationship vocabulary, and --check-declaration fails closed if
a named type is absent from it.

$derivation_comment: Derivation rules. Each rule says: an edge of this located type, read in this direction,
supports an entry in this lane. Nothing is written — the engine counts how many (artifact,
lane) pairs the located edges would support and how many of those the spine already carries,
and cites the located edge identifiers so every count is auditable. A rule naming a type
absent from the located vocabulary is a binding failure.

$obligation_class_comment: How an open lane obligation is classified. DISCHARGEABLE means the located vocabulary
provides a label that would populate the lane, so the obligation can be met by adding a row
to an artifact's own front matter and re-running the located generator — no code change.
MECHANISM-ABSENT means no located label names the lane at all, so the obligation cannot be
met by any means the repository currently provides; it is referred to the vocabulary owner.

findings.title: The constitutional traceability obligation and the thirteen-lane engineering spine were conflated under one word
findings.note: CEP-006 V.1 and CEP-007 V.1 both name the precondition as rooted-and-closed traceability under CEP-001 Article XVIII, which requires upward rooting, downward evidence, closure and zero orphans. The located measurement service instead reports one gap per artifact whose thirteen schema lanes are not all populated. Both are legitimate; they are not the same obligation, and only the first is a constitutional precondition. Closed by measuring them separately and reporting each against its own owner.

findings.title: Five of the thirteen spine lanes are named by no located label, so the completeness predicate has no reachable satisfying state
findings.note: The located relationship vocabulary maps labels to lanes. Measured from that vocabulary, several lanes of the thirteen-stage schema are named by no label at all, so no artifact can populate them through the located generator by any means. A predicate requiring all thirteen therefore cannot be satisfied by any legal repository state. This is recorded, quantified and referred to the vocabulary owner; it is not remediated here, because adding a label to the located vocabulary is a change to that owner's code and to the corpus it generates.

findings.title: Located structural edges already support lane entries the generator does not write
findings.note: The certified corpus already carries typed structural edges whose subject lanes the located vocabulary declares, but the generator writes lane entries only for edges derived from front-matter metadata rows, never for the structural edges it emits itself. The derivation register quantifies exactly how many lane entries the existing edges would support, citing each edge identifier. This programme writes none of them: the corpus is generated by its located owner and is read-only here. The headroom is recorded so the closure is a decision for that owner rather than an unknown.
